entities.summary: Paul Giger (b. 1952-08-30, Herisau) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Herisau and Switzerland. Known in the fields of switzerland, composers & musicians, europe.
